headline: Nigerian Exchange Sheds N1.1 Trillion as Investors Dump Banking and Telecom Stocks
summary: The Nigerian Exchange suffered a severe pullback, wiping out N1.098 trillion in market capitalization in a single session due to heavy selling of banking and telecom equities.
why: Broad market sell-offs reflect shifting local investor sentiment and liquidity adjustments across key sectors in African regional capital markets.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: Heavy selling pressure across banking and telecom stocks drives down market capitalization.

why_moved: Intense selling pressure and profit-taking in heavy-weight banking and telecommunications shares caused a sharp drop in equity market capitalization.
